units.source_text: 根据佛教传说，先于双亲死去的孩童为祭奠父母，

en.t: According to Buddhist legend, children who die before their parents, in order to honor them,

units.source_text: 想在前往冥府途中的河滩积石造塔，

en.t: try to pile stones into a tower on the riverbank along the road to the underworld,

units.source_text: 但石头一垒起来，就被妖魔破坏掉。

en.t: but as soon as the stones are stacked up, demons destroy them.
